common.noPermission: You do not have the right to see this page.
common.copyNote: Identifiers, checksums and table names are shown as they are stored, left to right.
common.notApproval: A transfer moves data or configuration. It never grants a business, Finance or IT approval.

export.title: Data export
export.intro: A migration export copies this whole installation, with its ids, links, audit history and evidence, into a package in IT-controlled storage. It never contains sessions, tokens or secret values.
export.requestHint: The export runs in the background. Only one export can be queued or running at a time.
export.requested: Export requested. Its status is shown in the list below.
export.empty: No migration export has been requested yet.

environment.label: Source data
environment.unmarked: Not marked as demo or production

export.downloadsNotReady: The manifests can be downloaded once the export has succeeded.
export.downloadsFailed: This export failed. Its manifests are not available.
export.unknownUntilDone: Unknown until the export has succeeded.

import.title: Migration status
import.cliOnly: Imports and identity rebinds are run by IT with the migration tools. This page is read-only.
import.empty: No migration has been imported into this installation.
import.reconciliationsEmpty: No reconciliation report exists for this import.
import.attachmentMismatchesEmpty: Every attachment has the expected size and SHA-256.

rebind.title: Identity rebind
rebind.empty: No moved account matches this filter.

bundle.title: Configuration transfer
bundle.intro: Export published configuration as a bundle, or import a bundle. An import creates drafts that go through the normal review and publishing; it never publishes anything.
bundle.nonDraftNote: Branding, the notification policy, review policies and the upload policy have no draft stage: committing applies them as a change. Job schedules are imported disabled.
bundle.kindsHint: Leave every kind unticked to export every listed kind that has a published version.
bundle.notCarriedNote: Not carried by a bundle: automation rules. Each rule names its owner by user ID, which another installation does not have, so recreate automation rules by hand there, with their own owners. Automation rule sets are carried.
bundle.exported: Bundle exported. It is listed below.
bundle.exportsEmpty: No bundle has been exported from this organization.
bundle.fileNotJson: The file is not valid JSON.
bundle.uploaded: Bundle uploaded. Validate it to see what it would change.
bundle.importsEmpty: No bundle has been uploaded to this organization.

action.label: Planned action
action.new_draft: New draft of an existing item

bundle.itemsEmpty: Validate the bundle to see the planned action of each item.
bundle.commitBlocked: Only a validated import without conflicts or refused items can be committed.
bundle.committedNote: Committed. The drafts now go through the normal review and publishing; nothing was published.
bundle.invalidNote: This import has a conflict or a refused item, so it can never be committed. Resolve the cause (for example, finish or discard the open draft) and upload the bundle again.
bundle.validated: Validated. Check the planned actions before you commit.
